preconditions.description: Number of test cases T is between 1 and 10.
Number of practice matches N is between 1 and 100000 for each test case.
Number of goals scored in each match gi is between 0 and 1000000.

postconditions.expression: for each test case, if there exists a pair of matches (i, j) such that i < j and gi < gj, then output the maximum value of gj - gi
postconditions.description: If there is an improvement in goals scored between any two matches, output the maximum improvement.

postconditions.expression: for each test case, if no such pair exists, output 'UNFIT'
postconditions.description: If there is no improvement in goals scored between any two matches, output 'UNFIT'.
